title: Coordination between 5GSM and ESM with N26 interface

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for transitioning from 5GS (N1 mode) to EPS (S1 mode) while maintaining PDU session continuity through mapped EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure for transitioning from EPS (S1 mode) to 5GS (N1 mode) while maintaining PDN connection continuity through mapped PDU sessions.

entities.name: PDU Session
entities.description: A 5GS session that can be mapped to EPS bearer contexts for inter-system mobility.

entities.name: Mapped EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: EPS bearer context information mapped from 5GS PDU sessions for inter-system change to S1 mode.

entities.name: QoS Flow
entities.description: 5GS QoS flow that can be mapped to EPS bearer contexts with specific QoS parameters.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: EPS bearer context created from mapped EPS bearer contexts or QoS flow associations during inter-system change.

entities.name: MA PDU Session
entities.description: Multi-access PDU session that can be established over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

entities.name: PDU session type to PDN type mapping
entities.description: Mapping rules between 5GS PDU session types and EPS PDN types for inter-system mobility.

entities.name: QoS Rule
entities.description: QoS rules that define packet filtering and QoS treatment for PDU sessions.

entities.name: QoS Flow Description
entities.description: Parameters describing QoS characteristics of a QoS flow for inter-system mobility.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: EPS message used to modify EPS bearer context parameters, including QoS rules and QoS flow descriptions.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: EPS message used to activate default EPS bearer context with QoS rules and QoS flow descriptions.

relations.description: Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode requires mapped EPS bearer contexts for PDU session continuity.
UE creates default and dedicated EPS bearer contexts based on mapped EPS bearer contexts during inter-system change.
PDU session contains mapped EPS bearer contexts for interworking with EPS.
QoS flows are mapped to EPS bearer contexts with specific EPS bearer identities and QoS parameters.
PDU session type to PDN type mapping rules govern the inter-system change procedure.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains QoS rules parameter.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains QoS flow descriptions parameter.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains QoS rules parameter.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains QoS flow descriptions parameter.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode creates corresponding PDU sessions from PDN connections.
MA PDU session behavior affects the inter-system change procedure, particularly for 3GPP access handling.
